events.name: sefaria-connections-category-change
events.description: Asks to show a different connection category. Call `preventDefault()` to stop the panel from switching to that category and returning to the first page.
events.detail: `category` is the chosen category's ID, or `null` for all categories.

events.name: sefaria-connections-preview-request
events.description: Requests connection previews. The element loads them unless a listener cancels the event. Call `preventDefault()` to stop the panel from loading previews itself. If you don't call it, a panel that loads from `sref` requests the connections again with their text.

events.name: sefaria-connections-page-change
events.description: Asks to show a different page of connections. Call `preventDefault()` to stop the panel from changing page.

events.name: sefaria-connection-select
events.description: Reports that a reader selected one connected reference. Call `preventDefault()` to do nothing. The panel has no default action for this event.
events.detail: `id` is the connection's ID. `targetRef` is the connected text's reference.

events.name: sefaria-connections-panel-error
events.description: Reports a failure while loading or validating data from `sref`.
events.detail: `error` is the original failure. `sref` is the reference that was loading.

events.name: sefaria-reader-back
events.description: Requests navigation to the previous entry. Call `preventDefault()` to stop the Reader from going back.
events.detail: `originEntryId`, the entry the Reader was showing

events.name: sefaria-reader-history-activate
events.description: Asks to return to one saved history entry. Call `preventDefault()` to stop the Reader from returning to that entry.
events.detail: `originEntryId` is the entry the Reader was showing. `entryId` is the history entry chosen. `label` is its label.

events.name: sefaria-reader-source-select
events.description: Reports that a reader selected one item in the source card. Call `preventDefault()` to stop the Reader from selecting that segment.
events.detail: `originEntryId` is the entry the Reader was showing. `position` and `ref` are the same as in `sefaria-source-select`.

events.name: sefaria-reader-connections-page-change

events.detail: `originEntryId` is the entry the Reader was showing. `page` is the same as in `sefaria-connections-page-change`.

events.name: sefaria-reader-connection-select
events.description: Reports that a reader selected one connected reference. Call `preventDefault()` to stop the Reader from opening the connected text.
events.detail: `originEntryId` is the entry the Reader was showing. `id` and `targetRef` are the same as in `sefaria-connection-select`.

events.name: sefaria-reader-connections-preview-request
events.description: Requests connection previews. The element loads them unless a listener cancels the event. Call `preventDefault()` to stop the Reader from loading previews.

events.name: sefaria-reader-error
events.description: Reports a failure while loading the starting text or a text you navigate to, or when loading is disabled.
events.detail: `error` is the original failure. `sref` is the reference the Reader was loading when the failure happened.

declarations.data: `data` takes the body of a successful `GET /api/v3/texts/{tref}` response, typed `CoreV3TextsResponse` from `@sefaria/api-client`. It also accepts a `TextSegmentSelectedData` object with `kind: "selected"`. When `data` is defined, the element uses it instead of loading `sref`, even when it is invalid. It treats the value as a status 200 response.
declarations.empty: The element shows its empty state when the chosen edition has no text. The message depends on how the edition was chosen. If the default primary edition is missing, you see `No primary text is available.` If an edition you selected has no text, you can see a message that names that edition. On some paths, the element shows the response's warning instead.
